title: Brass Band Rehearsal Scheduler Development Task Board
originalRequest: Create an automated scheduling system for a brass band to manage rehearsals, attendance, venues, piece repertoire, and instrument inventory.
latestMessage: Create an automated scheduling system for a brass band to manage rehearsals, attendance, venues, piece repertoire, and instrument inventory.

steps.title: Analyze requirements for the brass band rehearsal scheduler database schema
steps.instruction: Define the core entities (Musician, Section, Rehearsal, Attendance, Piece) and their relationships.
steps.acceptance: A schema diagram or text specification covering all entities and relational constraints.
steps.result: Schema design completed. Defined tables for Musician, Section (e.g., Solo Cornet, Euphonium), Rehearsal (date, time, venue), Attendance (status: attending, absent, late), and Piece (title, composer).

steps.title: Initialize the project repository and database migrations
steps.instruction: Create the basic project setup using PostgreSQL and apply the initial schema migrations.
steps.acceptance: Repository compiled, migrations applied successfully, and schema verified.
steps.result: Attempt 1 failed due to driver compatibility issues with our testing pipeline. Attempt 2 succeeded after migrating to node-postgres and applying schema changes to local SQLite environment.

steps.title: Set up automated unit test framework
steps.instruction: Integrate a testing library like Jest and write tests for model creation.
steps.acceptance: Test suite runs and passes with mock database instances.
steps.result: Attempt 1 failed because of database state sharing between parallel worker processes. Attempt 2 resolved the issue by introducing in-memory DB isolation for individual test runner processes.

steps.title: Implement Musician and Section CRUD operations
steps.instruction: Create API endpoints to add, retrieve, update, and delete musicians and sections.
steps.acceptance: REST endpoints verified with correct status codes and JSON payloads.
steps.result: REST endpoints for /api/musicians and /api/sections completed. Implemented validation to ensure musicians are assigned to valid sections.

steps.title: Implement Rehearsal scheduling logic
steps.instruction: Implement the core scheduling algorithm preventing double-booking of venues and overlapping times.
steps.acceptance: Error returned if a rehearsal is scheduled at the same venue and overlapping time slot.
steps.result: Attempt 1 had a logic error failing to detect overlaps when times shared exact boundary limits. Attempt 2 corrected this by rewriting database interval comparison logic.

steps.title: Create Attendance tracking API
steps.instruction: Implement endpoint allowing musicians or section leaders to mark attendance status for a rehearsal.
steps.acceptance: Attendance record can be queried and updated per musician per rehearsal.
steps.result: Attempt 1 hit concurrency lock issues when section leaders sent rapid updates. Attempt 2 uses database transactions with row-level locks on rehearsal attendance updates.

steps.title: Develop Section-specific rehearsal notification dispatch
steps.instruction: Implement a notification system to alert specific sections (e.g., "Trombones only") about sectionals.
steps.acceptance: Filtering mechanism correctly identifies target musicians and triggers a mock notification event.
steps.result: Created notification service. Filtered by Section ID, successfully dispatching mock emails to selected section members.

steps.title: Implement Repertoire/Piece management
steps.instruction: Integrate Piece table with Rehearsals to indicate which pieces will be rehearsed during a session.
steps.acceptance: Many-to-many relationship table 'rehearsal_pieces' with estimated time allocation per piece.
steps.result: Repertoire integration complete. Rehearsal creation now accepts an array of piece IDs with associated duration parameters.

steps.title: Verify data integrity and cascade deletes
steps.instruction: Ensure deleting a rehearsal cascades and cleans up associated attendance and piece mappings.
steps.acceptance: Deletion of a rehearsal clears records in attendance and rehearsal_pieces tables.
steps.result: Verified cascading foreign keys work as expected. Written tests to confirm orphaned records are avoided.

steps.title: Clarify conflict resolution rules for instrument double-booking
steps.instruction: Ask owner if a musician who plays multiple instruments (e.g., Cornet and Trumpet) can be scheduled for overlapping sectionals.
steps.acceptance: User feedback on whether to allow or block multi-instrument scheduling conflicts.

steps.title: Refactor schedule conflict algorithm based on feedback
steps.instruction: Implement scheduling rules allowing multi-instrument musicians to be scheduled but trigger a soft warning instead of hard block.
steps.acceptance: API returns a warning payload when an overlap occurs for a multi-instrumentalist.
steps.result: Updated validation logic to return code 209 (Conflict Warning) instead of 400 when the musician has secondary instrument capabilities.

steps.title: Implement Venue availability checker
steps.instruction: Build an API to query available venues on a given date range.
steps.acceptance: Returns list of unoccupied venues based on existing rehearsal reservations.
steps.result: Built GET /api/venues/available endpoint. Returns accurate list of free venues filtering out active rehearsal intervals.

steps.title: Implement User authentication and roles
steps.instruction: Set up basic JWT authentication with roles: Conductor, Section Leader, Musician.
steps.acceptance: Protected endpoints reject unauthorized access and enforce role limits.
steps.result: Auth system established. Conductor role can schedule, Section Leaders can update section attendance, Musicians can view schedule.

steps.title: Implement rehearsal cancellation and notification dispatch
steps.instruction: Create endpoint to cancel a rehearsal and flag all scheduled attendees.
steps.acceptance: Rehearsal status updated to 'cancelled' and attendance records adjusted.
steps.result: Cancellation API created. Successfully updates state and triggers alerts to assigned musicians.

steps.title: Integrate calendar sync (iCal format)
steps.instruction: Generate iCal export link for musicians to sync rehearsal schedules to external calendars.
steps.acceptance: iCal format generation validated.
steps.result: Blocked due to external library compatibility. The server environment is missing timezone compilation dependencies required by the ics-generation package, preventing the server from launching when imported.

steps.title: Clarify offline/alternative approach for calendar export
steps.instruction: Ask owner if we should fall back to basic JSON-to-CSV schedule export until system dependencies are updated.
steps.acceptance: Owner confirmation on fallback strategy.

steps.title: Implement CSV Schedule Export
steps.instruction: Create an endpoint to download the band's rehearsal schedule as a CSV file.
steps.acceptance: CSV download works and contains columns: Date, Time, Venue, Repertoire, Target Sections.
steps.result: CSV export endpoint implemented at /api/schedule/export. CSV format structured and validated.

steps.title: Verify CSV parser and encoding formats
steps.instruction: Ensure CSV handles special characters in composer names and rehearsal titles (e.g., French accents).
steps.acceptance: CSV export handles UTF-8 characters without corruption.
steps.result: Verified CSV encoding is forced to UTF-8 with BOM. Tests confirm diacritics in "Dukas" or "Saint-Saëns" render correctly.

steps.title: Inquire about automated reminder schedule
steps.instruction: Ask the owner how many hours before a rehearsal the automatic attendance reminder should be sent.
steps.acceptance: Timeframe specification received.

steps.title: Implement Cron scheduler for attendance reminders
steps.instruction: Build a scheduled task to send reminders to musicians who haven't RSVP'd yet.
steps.acceptance: Cron job queries unconfirmed attendances and logs mock notifications.
steps.result: Scheduled job configured to run daily. Successfully flags and processes unconfirmed attendance lists.

steps.title: Add dashboard statistics API
steps.instruction: Calculate metrics: attendance rate per section, upcoming rehearsal count, and repertoire coverage.
steps.acceptance: Endpoint /api/dashboard/stats returns correct counts and calculations.
steps.result: Dashboard API completed. Returns aggregate metrics grouped by section (e.g., Trombones, Horns) accurately.

steps.title: Validate statistics computations under heavy load
steps.instruction: Write load test simulation checking response times of stats endpoint with 10,000 rehearsal records.
steps.acceptance: Response times remain under 200ms with index optimizations.
steps.result: Optimized query using indexing on rehearsal_date and attendance_status. Load test confirmed average response time of 85ms.

steps.title: Ask owner about performance report formatting
steps.instruction: Request confirmation on whether the weekly stats report should be emailed directly to the Conductor.
steps.acceptance: Feedback on target recipients and report frequency.

steps.title: Implement automated email reports for Conductors
steps.instruction: Code task to compile weekly performance stats and send a mock report to Conductor accounts.
steps.acceptance: Scheduler triggers weekly run and compiles statistics successfully.
steps.result: Weekly report generation logic implemented. Sends mock emails containing formatted HTML tables to designated conductor addresses.

steps.title: Implement rehearsal feedback system
steps.instruction: Allow conductors to add notes/comments to a completed rehearsal regarding sections that need more practice.
steps.acceptance: PUT /api/rehearsals/:id/notes updates rehearsal feedback string.
steps.result: Notes field added to Rehearsal model and update endpoint verified.

steps.title: Add section leader override feature
steps.instruction: Allow section leaders to edit attendance logs for their section even after a rehearsal is completed.
steps.acceptance: Authorization check permits section leaders to override records up to 7 days post-event.
steps.result: Override window constraint implemented. API blocks override requests if the rehearsal date is older than 7 days.

steps.title: Implement rehearsal duration calculator
steps.instruction: Create helper logic to sum up allocated times for pieces to ensure total rehearsal duration is not exceeded.
steps.acceptance: Validation flags a warning if combined piece durations exceed the scheduled rehearsal length.
steps.result: Added validation to rehearsal pieces association endpoint. Properly alerts when piece times total 130 minutes on a 120-minute slot.

steps.title: Add venue capacity warning mechanism
steps.instruction: Compare venue capacity against active musicians scheduled to attend a rehearsal.
steps.acceptance: Returns alert if count of expected musicians exceeds maximum capacity of the venue.
steps.result: Capacity validation added. Evaluates musician section assignments against venue seating constraints and raises warnings.

steps.title: Implement band inventory/instrument list
steps.instruction: Add tracking for band-owned instruments loaned to musicians (e.g., Eb Soprano Cornet, Bb Bass).
steps.acceptance: CRUD endpoints for instruments and assignment tracking to musicians.
steps.result: Loan inventory endpoints completed. Successfully tracks instrument model, serial number, and current assignee.

steps.title: Integrate inventory warnings with rehearsals
steps.instruction: Warn if a piece requires an instrument (e.g., Percussion - Timpani) that is currently marked as out of service.
steps.acceptance: Schedule endpoint cross-references instrument status and flags warnings.
steps.result: Validation check integrated. Scans piece requirements against broken or unassigned inventory items.

steps.title: Standardize API error responses
steps.instruction: Implement uniform JSON structure for all API errors and exception handling middleware.
steps.acceptance: All errors return { error: string, code: string, timestamp: string }.
steps.result: Global exception handler middleware deployed. Standardized error structure applied to all existing controllers.

steps.title: Create database backup script
steps.instruction: Write a shell utility to dump SQLite/Postgres database structure and data to a backup folder.
steps.acceptance: Script runs successfully and generates verified gzip archive.
steps.result: Backup script configured and verified. Successfully exports and compresses schema and data.

steps.title: Final end-to-end rehearsal scheduling flow verification
steps.instruction: Execute complete script creating a venue, scheduling a rehearsal, adding pieces, registering attendance, and exporting stats.
steps.acceptance: All operations succeed in logical sequence without manual intervention.
steps.result: E2E scenario successfully tested. All systems integrated, from initial schedule creation to post-rehearsal stats compilation.
